description_en: Assigns a driver to an edge instance
description_zh: 将驱动分配到边缘实例中
kebab_example: aliyun iot bind-driver-to-edge-instance --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --driver-id 9c1ae7bd59f1469abbdccc9592280000 --driver-version 2.0.0 --order-id 111234587650000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindDriverToEdgeInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the driver. On the Driver Management page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target driver to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the driver. If this parameter is left empty, the latest version of the driver is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 驱动版本号。为空则默认为最新版本驱动
parameters.name: driver_version

parameters.help_en:
The order ID.

This parameter is required when the driver is a purchased driver. This parameter is not required when the driver is an official or self-developed driver
parameters.help_zh:
订单编号。

当驱动为已购驱动时必填；驱动为官方驱动或自研驱动时不需要填写
parameters.name: order_id
